description: This file implements the Write-Ahead Log (WAL) functionality for etcd's storage layer, including creation, opening, reading, writing, segment management, and verification of WAL files.

classes.name: WAL
classes.description: Represents the write-ahead log storage, managing file segments, reading, writing, and synchronization.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new WAL instance with initial setup, including directory creation, file initialization, and segment preallocation.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens an existing WAL at a specified directory and snapshot, preparing it for reading or appending.

methods.name: OpenForRead
methods.description: Opens the WAL files in read-only mode for verification or inspection.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of WAL files and checks for corruption or mismatched snapshots.

methods.name: ValidSnapshotEntries
methods.description: Returns all valid snapshot entries in the WAL logs up to the most recent committed hardstate.
